name: multiplai-context
description: Context routing, continuous learning, session awareness, and memory management for Claude Code.

workspace_dir.title: Workspace Root
workspace_dir.description: Workspace root. When set, memory/diary/now/learnings default to $workspace_dir/.multiplai/{...}. Falls back to ~/.multiplai/ if unset. Specific *_dir overrides win over this.

memory_dir.title: Memory Directory
memory_dir.description: Directory for memory files (me.md, technical-pref.md, preferences.md). Defaults to <workspace_dir>/.multiplai/memory if workspace_dir is set, else ~/.multiplai/memory.

diary_dir.title: Diary Directory
diary_dir.description: Directory for diary entries and session logs. Defaults to <workspace_dir>/.multiplai/diary if workspace_dir is set, else ~/.multiplai/diary.

now_dir.title: Now Directory
now_dir.description: Per-project status (now-files) directory written by synthesize_now. Defaults to <workspace_dir>/.multiplai/now if workspace_dir is set, else ~/.multiplai/now.

learnings_dir.title: Learnings Directory
learnings_dir.description: Per-day structured learnings directory written by extract_learnings. Defaults to <workspace_dir>/.multiplai/learnings if workspace_dir is set, else ~/.multiplai/learnings.

data_dir.title: Runtime Data Directory
data_dir.description: Runtime state directory for logs, catalogs, and dream state. Defaults to <workspace_dir>/.multiplai/data if workspace_dir is set, else ~/.multiplai/data. Not CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA — runtime state stays with the workspace.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API Key
anthropic_api_key.description: Anthropic API key for fallback when Agent SDK is unavailable

catalog_model.title: Catalog Model
catalog_model.description: Model to use for LLM-based catalog generation calls

catalog_model_diary.title: Catalog Model (Diary)
catalog_model_diary.description: Override model for diary catalog generation (volume optimization). Empty = inherit catalog_model.

catalog_ttl_hours.title: Catalog TTL (Hours)
catalog_ttl_hours.description: Hours a generated catalog remains valid before being considered stale

diary_catalog_days.title: Diary Catalog Days
diary_catalog_days.description: Number of days of diary history the diary catalog generator processes

catalog_concurrency.title: Catalog Generation Concurrency
catalog_concurrency.description: How many catalog-generation model calls run at once. 5 is comfortable for the Anthropic API; raise it only if you have higher quotas.

enable_skills.title: Enable Skills Catalog
enable_skills.description: Whether the skills catalog generator runs during catalog generation

skills_dir.title: Skills Directory
skills_dir.description: Directory to scan for skills when enable_skills is true

plugins_dir.title: Plugins Directory
plugins_dir.description: Directory holding installed_plugins.json, used to discover plugin-bundled skills when enable_skills is true. Empty = $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/plugins.

enable_resources.title: Enable Resources Retrieval
enable_resources.description: Whether a resources corpus is retrieved per prompt. Requires resources_dir and a qmd index over it (see README → qmd retrieval for host prerequisites). Off means no resources are ever injected.

resources_dir.title: Resources Directory
resources_dir.description: Directory holding the resources corpus, indexed by qmd. Read when enable_resources is true.

qmd_mode.title: qmd Execution Mode
qmd_mode.description: Where qmd runs: 'http' (POST an authored typed query to a resident 'qmd mcp --http' daemon on the host — preferred: warm models, no per-prompt cold start, qmd does the fusion+rerank), 'local' (qmd on PATH — native installs), or 'ssh' (qmd on the host over the container→host SSH bridge).

qmd_http_url.title: qmd HTTP Daemon URL
qmd_http_url.description: Base URL of the 'qmd mcp --http' daemon for qmd_mode 'http'. The daemon must bind 0.0.0.0 (not localhost) to be reachable from the container. POSTs to <url>/query. SECURITY: binding 0.0.0.0 exposes an UNAUTHENTICATED read-only HTTP endpoint over the entire indexed corpus to every device on the LAN unless scoped. On macOS, scope :8181 to the container subnet with a pf/firewall rule — see README → 'Exposure of the http daemon' for a concrete pf example.

qmd_collection.title: qmd Collection
qmd_collection.description: qmd collection name holding the resources index.

qmd_strategy.title: qmd Search Strategy (local/ssh only)
qmd_strategy.description: Ignored in 'http' mode (the daemon fuses + reranks). For 'local'/'ssh': 'fused' (vsearch + BM25 merged by reciprocal rank, ~1-2s), 'hybrid' (qmd query with expansion + rerank, best quality but slow), or 'fts' (BM25 only, no embeddings needed).

qmd_candidate_limit.title: qmd Candidate Limit (http)
qmd_candidate_limit.description: How many candidate docs the daemon reranks per query in 'http' mode. The main latency dial (rerank time is linear: ~0.58s/doc). 10 is a good default. The HTTP request timeout scales with this dial (max(10s, 3 + 0.7s/doc)), so raising it also lengthens the worst-case wait per prompt. Capped at 50 (a bounded worst-case wait of ~38s).

qmd_min_score.title: qmd Minimum Score
qmd_min_score.description: Drop retrieved results scoring below this (0–1) rather than inject weak matches. Applies to all qmd modes.

memory_router.title: Memory Router
memory_router.description: Routing strategy for context selection: 'token_overlap' (offline, fast) or 'llm' (semantic match, one model call per prompt). 'embeddings' is reserved for a future port.

router_model.title: Router Model (llm strategy)
router_model.description: Model used by the 'llm' memory_router. Defaults to Haiku — routing is a cheap classification, so the smallest/fastest model keeps the per-prompt hook latency tolerable. Ignored under 'token_overlap'.

router_timeout_seconds.title: Router Timeout (llm strategy)
router_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds the 'llm' memory_router waits before giving up. A timeout injects NO memory for that turn, so raise this if you see 'LLMRouter timed out' warnings — section anchors make each call read a longer catalog and choose more finely, which pushes some prompts over the default. Ignored under 'token_overlap'.

router_thinking.title: Router Extended Thinking
router_thinking.description: Extended thinking on 'llm'/'llm_hybrid' router calls. Off by default, and that is what makes LLM routing fit the per-prompt hook budget: a cold routing call takes 18.4s with thinking on and 2.9s with it off, against a 30s budget. Set true/1/yes/on to restore thinking. If the installed multiplai-core or claude-agent-sdk is too old to carry the setting, the plugin warns once, keeps thinking on, and keeps working.

extraction_thinking.title: Extraction Extended Thinking
extraction_thinking.description: Extended thinking on the diary/learnings extraction call. Off by default: extraction is structured parsing over a distilled transcript, and a cold call drops 18.4s -> 2.9s with thinking off (measured 2026-08-09). Set true/1/yes/on to restore thinking. If the installed multiplai-core or claude-agent-sdk is too old to carry the setting, the plugin warns once, keeps thinking on, and keeps working.

checkpoint_thinking.title: Checkpoint Writer Extended Thinking
checkpoint_thinking.description: Extended thinking on the checkpoint writer's model call. Off by default: folding a transcript segment into a fixed six-section document is mechanical summarisation. Set true/1/yes/on to restore thinking. If the installed multiplai-core or claude-agent-sdk is too old to carry the setting, the plugin warns once, keeps thinking on, and keeps working.

duplication_thinking.title: Memory Doctor Duplication Extended Thinking
duplication_thinking.description: Extended thinking on the memory doctor's duplication-confirmation call (stage 2), and on that call only. Off by default: deciding whether two lines make the same claim is verdict extraction over text the model sees in full. The doctor's contradiction pass is NOT covered and keeps extended thinking on — deciding whether two statements can both be true is judgement, so it is left alone and has no switch. Set true/1/yes/on to restore thinking. If the installed multiplai-core or claude-agent-sdk is too old to carry the setting, the plugin warns once, keeps thinking on, and keeps working.

utilisation_thinking.title: Utilisation Judge Extended Thinking
utilisation_thinking.description: Extended thinking on the offline utilisation judge's calls. Off by default: judging is per-section verdict extraction from a distilled transcript. Set true/1/yes/on to restore thinking. If the installed multiplai-core or claude-agent-sdk is too old to carry the setting, the plugin warns once, keeps thinking on, and keeps working.

now_thinking.title: Now-Summary Extended Thinking
now_thinking.description: Extended thinking on the per-project now/ status summary calls. Off by default: a 3-5 bullet status summary over diary snippets is mechanical. Set true/1/yes/on to restore thinking. If the installed multiplai-core or claude-agent-sdk is too old to carry the setting, the plugin warns once, keeps thinking on, and keeps working.

catalog_thinking.title: Catalog Generator Extended Thinking
catalog_thinking.description: Extended thinking on catalog-generation calls (memory, banks, skills, diary generators). Off by default: producing structured JSON catalog entries is mechanical. Set true/1/yes/on to restore thinking. If the installed multiplai-core or claude-agent-sdk is too old to carry the setting, the plugin warns once, keeps thinking on, and keeps working.

recommend_cooldown_turns.title: Re-recommendation Cooldown (Turns)
recommend_cooldown_turns.description: After a file is injected, suppress re-recommending it for this many turns (it's already in the conversation). Reset on context compaction. 0 disables the cooldown.

keep_ratio.title: Memory Relevance Cutoff (keep_ratio)
keep_ratio.description: token_overlap router: keep a memory file only if it scores at least this fraction of the top match (0-1). Higher = stricter (fewer, more-relevant files, less 10-file cap saturation); lower admits more of the weaker tail. Default 0.30. Ignored under the 'llm' strategy.

enable_costs.title: Enable Cost Collection
enable_costs.description: When on, session start fires a detached, flock-guarded collector that prices Claude Code session transcripts into a local monthly cost ledger (queryable via /multiplai-context:costs). Local-only; nothing leaves the machine. Incremental after the first backfill.

memory_conflict_preamble.title: Memory Conflict Surfacing
memory_conflict_preamble.description: Render a conflict-surfacing directive plus per-file last-updated stamps above every injected MEMORY block, making the model flag memory-vs-session disagreements to the user. Costs ~90 tokens per memory-carrying turn; turn off to save them.

utilisation_judge_sample.title: Utilisation Judge Sample Size
utilisation_judge_sample.description: How many recent sessions the nightly offline utilisation judge rules on per maintenance run. It is the independent check on the session's own (upward-biased) self-report of which injected memory it used; both numbers are reported side by side and always labelled estimates. 0 turns the judge off, leaving self-report as the only estimator.

enable_dev_references.title: Dev Reference Injection
enable_dev_references.description: Detect the project's stack from its manifests and inject pointers to the matching engineering-standards docs under $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/reference/dev/ (paths and section index, not contents), once per session per project. Silently does nothing when that directory does not exist.

memory_write_mode.title: Memory Write Mode
memory_write_mode.description: How much of a dream proposal may be written to memory without you reading it. 'review' = nothing is applied automatically (the pre-0.36.0 behaviour). 'triage' (default) = a model judges each item and only items the provenance/kind rubric permits are applied, each one recorded in a receipt. 'auto' = also applies plain facts the rubric would have held back. Rules never apply automatically in any mode, and a model failure always falls back to leaving everything for you.

memory_banks_file.title: Memory Banks File
memory_banks_file.description: Path to the YAML file declaring shared memory banks. Defaults to memory-banks.yaml at your workspace's .multiplai/ root, beside project-map.yaml. Leave blank unless your banks are declared somewhere else.

bank_sync_ttl_hours.title: Bank Sync Interval (hours)
bank_sync_ttl_hours.description: How long a shared bank's content stays fresh before a session start fast-forwards it again. The pull runs detached and a failure leaves the previous content in place, so a bank you cannot reach is stale, never broken.

checkpoint_enabled.title: Enable Checkpoints
checkpoint_enabled.description: Master switch for the checkpoint system: periodic saves of a session's working state, the handoff nudge, and the /clear rebuild. Off means no writes, no nudges and no rebuild.

checkpoint_tokens.title: Checkpoint Bands
checkpoint_tokens.description: Comma-separated absolute token counts at which a session checkpoints. Crossing a band spawns the detached writer once.

checkpoint_handoff_tokens.title: Handoff Threshold (Tokens)
checkpoint_handoff_tokens.description: Where the /clear handoff advice starts. Clamped to at least the highest band, so a partial override cannot ask for a handoff below the last checkpoint. Defaults to the highest band.

checkpoint_refresh_tokens.title: Refresh Growth (Tokens)
checkpoint_refresh_tokens.description: Re-checkpoint after this much context growth since the last write, so a long session's saved state never trails far behind.

checkpoint_hard_stop_tokens.title: Hard Stop (Tokens)
checkpoint_hard_stop_tokens.description: Above this, new prompts are refused until you hand off. 0 keeps the handoff purely advisory, which is the default — a block is a behaviour to choose, because getting it wrong means a session that refuses to talk. Clamped to at least the handoff threshold.

checkpoint_stale_hours.title: Staleness Trigger (Hours)
checkpoint_stale_hours.description: Re-checkpoint when the last one is this old, regardless of token growth — this is what saves the tab you left open, which crosses no band. 0 disables it, restoring size-only triggering.

checkpoint_min_session_minutes.title: Minimum Session Age (Minutes)
checkpoint_min_session_minutes.description: How old a session must be before the staleness trigger applies, so a short session does not checkpoint just for existing.

checkpoint_ttl_hours.title: Rebuild Marker TTL (Hours)
checkpoint_ttl_hours.description: How long a pending rebuild marker stays claimable — i.e. how long after a handoff a /clear still restores that session. Unrelated to checkpoint_stale_hours.

checkpoint_gc_days.title: Checkpoint Retention (Days)
checkpoint_gc_days.description: Collect a session's saved working state once nothing has touched it for this long. A checkpoint holds intent, files touched and errors, so keeping them forever is a privacy surface as well as disk. 0 keeps every checkpoint indefinitely.

checkpoint_timeout_s.title: Writer Timeout (Seconds)
checkpoint_timeout_s.description: Model-call timeout for the checkpoint writer. The writer is detached and nothing waits on it, so a generous ceiling costs nothing while a tight one costs the whole checkpoint.

checkpoint_model.title: Checkpoint Writer Model
checkpoint_model.description: Model used by the checkpoint writer. Empty uses the plugin's default model.
